thread:
marie-cs: Quick sync: Sirocco reported higher than normal per-token costs and 99th percentile tail latency in eu-west during morning spike. Renewal convo in ~3w. Thinking: trial aggressive int8 on stateless short-chat routes, fall back to a smaller local model for <64 token responses, and route peak traffic to a reserved EU pool. Thoughts?

diego-se: Sounds good. Two quick asks: 1) can we run their real prompts in staging before any swap; 2) ensure tokenizer edge cases covered (we saw a utf-8 edgecase with int8 on last run).

ravi-ml: I can do a small offline calibration and run a quality delta on their sample set. Recommend per-layer quant + keep fp16 for context windows >400 tokens. Also propose a tiny-format-preserve rule: system prompts stay fp16.

olivia-ops: Routing sketch for canary (5% -> 25%):
```json
{"policy":"path_and_size","routes":[{"path":"/v1/chat","max_tokens":64,"model":"sirocco-orca-mini","weight":0.05,"pool":"eu-dedicated"},{"path":"/v1/chat","max_tokens":null,"model":"redwood-13b-int8","weight":0.9,"pool":"shared-eu"}]}
```
Canary window: 1h morning slot. Will add token-level tracing.

deploy-bot: Canary created: deployment.sirocco -> eu-dedicated @1712345700 (5% for 1h). Monitors: p95_latency, p99_latency, gen_quality_delta, cost_per_k_tokens.

marie-cs: I'll request ~250 non-sensitive prompts and permission to run the canary. Also scheduling an enablement call Tue 09:30 CET (their spike 08:30-10:00 CET).

diego-se: Rollback thresholds: revert if p95 latency up >12% or gen_quality_delta >1.2% absolute. Capture a cost delta line item for renewal talking points.

ravi-ml: ETA for evaluation artifacts: 24h. I'll produce a tiny dashboard: baseline vs int8 vs orca-mini, plus 30 manual spot checks for safety.

olivia-ops: I'll wire up alerts to the channel and attach the tracing link. If quality drifts, we can automatically reduce weight to 0% and failover to fp16.

marie-cs: Owner list: @ravi-ml (eval + quality), @diego-se (deploy + rollback), @olivia-ops (routing/canary), me for customer comms. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Will update once prompts arrive.
